_comment: Fill this in, save as pairs.json next to it, then run:  ./run pairs
Paths may be absolute, or relative to this file. Any of .tif .tiff .png .jpg.
'note' is free text -- if you know roughly where the SEM sits in the TXM
frame, say so; it is not required but it narrows the search.
_txm_um_per_px_help: The single most useful number. Any ONE of these is enough and I will convert:
- field of view in um for one frame, plus which frame it was
- objective (20x, 40x ...) + detector binning + camera pixel size
If different frames used different magnifications, use txm_um_per_px_by_frame
below instead and leave this null.
